title: openai-responses: support seed/determinism flags and metadata passthrough; streaming & function-call stability fixes
author: Ava Chen
description:
Summary: Add OpenAI 'Responses' compatibility for newer endpoint features: deterministic/seed flags passthrough, top-level metadata passthrough, and improvements to streaming stability and function/tool-calling metadata routing. Motivation: customers are adopting the OpenAI Responses API surface; Redwood should preserve parity for deterministic runs (seed/determinism), allow user-supplied per-request metadata to propagate to logs/audit/tracing, and fix edgecases where streaming+function-calling caused truncated tool payloads. This PR touches the openai-compat layer, server-side request handling, runtime streaming hooks, and adds tests/docs.

Checklist: - [x] Pass-through seed/determinism flags from OpenAI-style request to runtime execution config - [x] Preserve and surface request metadata (x-request-metadata / openai.metadata) to audit logs and downstream tools - [x] Stabilize streaming: fix race on stream end handshake that caused truncated tool payloads (seen in perf canary) - [x] Add unit + integration tests for seed determinism and metadata passthrough - [x] Update docs and compatibility tests suite - [x] Add migration note for older clients (no breaking change)

Context and design notes: We map the OpenAI Responses fields to Redwood's internal request model: "seed" and "deterministic" are translated into a runtime pseudo-rng seed + deterministic flag to force sampling fallback to argmax where supported. If deterministic is true and seed omitted, we set seed=0 for reproducibility. Metadata is accepted as arbitrary JSON-serializable key/value map under openai.metadata and is stored in request.audit_metadata and forwarded to downstream tool invocation as tool_context.metadata. Streaming stability: previous behavior closed the stream before the final tool result flush when a function/tool call included a large json payload; root cause was an async flush ordering between token-stream and tool-result future. Fix: introduced an explicit end-of-function-token handshake and ensured buffered KV cache flush happens before stream close.

Compatibility notes: No breaking changes to existing Redwood API. OpenAI-compat clients gain new passthrough behavior. Deterministic behavior depends on model support; when model does not support deterministic sampling we fall back to best-effort seeding and log a warning in request.trace.

Related: linear/ENG-4123, SUP-2241 (customer report), internal perf canary pr-21022 (streaming repro).

O'Connor) 3) feat(audit): attach openai.metadata -> request.audit_metadata (P. Nair) 4) test: add integration tests for seed/deterministic + metadata passthrough (S. Martinez) 5) docs: add compatibility notes and quickstart example (A. Chen)
files_changed:
High-level files changed: 
- openai-compat/handler.go: add parsing of responses.seed and deterministic flags and metadata passthrough into RequestOptions (small safe change).
- runtime/execute.go: accept seed + deterministic and annotate random generator; added deterministic codepath with seed injection.
- runtime/streaming/streamer.go: add end-of-function handshake and buffer flush ordering fix (core of streaming stability fix).
- tools/runner.go: forward request.audit_metadata into tool invocation context.
- integration/tests/test_responses_compat.py: new integration tests for deterministic runs and metadata propagation.
- docs/openai-compat.md: added examples and migration notes.

Snippets: in openai-compat/handler.go we now include: 
  // capture seed/deterministic and metadata
  opts.Seed = payload.Seed
  opts.Deterministic = payload.Deterministic
  opts.AuditMetadata = payload.Metadata // forwarded to audit logs and tools

No large diffs; changes focus on plumbing and tests.
review_comments: Riley Patel: Left a couple of nit comments on error paths and logging level for deterministic fallbacks. Please ensure we don't log PII into audit_metadata.

Ava Chen: Responded - added sanitization hook to strip known PII keys (email, ssn) from metadata before persisting; moved fallback logs to debug.

Sofia Martinez: Noted we should add an integration test where deterministic=true but model lacks support (we should verify reproducibility is best-effort).
Ethan Brooks: Approved after fixing race condition in streamer.go and adding comment explaining handshake. CI flakes addressed by reordering flush; LGTM.
release_notes:
- Add OpenAI Responses compatibility for seed/determinism flags and metadata passthrough.
- Improve streaming stability for function/tool calls to avoid truncated payloads.
- No breaking changes.
